# sports-tech

Intro paragraph.

## Selection contract

<!-- Read by packages/research-enrich to judge whether a document belongs in this topic. English on purpose. -->

- **Purpose:** Decide which US basketball and tennis measurement products, athlete-data rights, and population opportunities are worth testing.
- **Core:** Basketball and tennis athlete sensing (wearables, inertial units, validity and reliability), companies and offers, data-integration routes and rights, and US league or participation counts used as denominators. Other sports are comparison, not the market decision.
- **Adjacent (keep):** Training or intervention studies that measure athletes with a sensor or other measurement method. Health science, materials, rehabilitation, and robotics only when they offer a measurement that might transfer, including American football, swimming, ski, sweat, and ultrasound. Association football only when a measurement method transfers. Performance analysis, match demands, athlete profiling, talent identification and outcome prediction in other sports, kept as comparison because the topic uses other sports as benchmarks.
- **Collected on purpose:** Europe PMC full texts, official league and governing documents (NCAA, NFHS), vendor API docs and product pages, the complete Hang-Time HAR and MoveSmart dumps (including unlabeled or unpaired files), and the search-response logs under raw/acquisition.
- **Out of scope:** Treatments or clinical outcomes with no measurement method. Non-human biology with no transferable sensing method. Congress abstracts and correction or retraction notices that are not a full measurement study. Roster, recruiting, team-admin pages, identical press releases, and pages that are only a script shell, when they neither measure an athlete nor grant data access.
